newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Philippines' SM Int'l raises FRN to US$110 mln.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' SM Int'l raises FRN to US$110 mln.

text.p: SM International Ltd's floating rate note issue has been increased to US$110 million from US$100 million, joint lead manager Merrill Lynch said on Monday.
The notes, which were launched last Friday, are now free to trade.
The notes were launched via special purpose vehicle SM International and guaranteed by SM Investments Corp, which is the holding company parent of shopping mall developer SM Prime.
The facility is due on November 14, 2002. It was priced at par to float at 100 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 105.5 basis points.
LTCB Asia is the other joint lead manager.
